Hi all - thanks, Marissa and Sarah. Quick answers and artifacts attached.

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (report period ending Dec 2025). We can provide a redacted SOC 2 report directly; full report requires an NDA and an authorized request.

Pen test: External pen test (third-party) completed Nov 2025. We do not share the full raw findings externally without NDA; however we provide an executive summary for procurement/security reviews - attached: Redwood_PenTest_ExecSummary_2025.pdf.

Vulnerability management (summary):
- Scanning cadence: Weekly authenticated internal scans, weekly external unauthenticated scans, monthly dependency scans, quarterly full external pen testing.
- Triage & SLA: P1 (critical/exploitable) acknowledged within 4 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours; P2 (high) triaged within 48 hours, mitigation plan within 2 weeks.
- Disclosure: Coordinated disclosure policy; we open a tracking JIRA ticket for each customer-reported item (example: JIRA SUP-1234). We coordinate timelines with customer security teams for joint remediation & validation.
- Remediation verification: we run follow-up scans and offer re-test windows for customers under NDA.

Attachments provided: Redwood_PenTest_ExecSummary_2025.pdf (exec summary) and Vuln_Management_Process.md (process overview). For sharing full reports we can route via legal/NDA - happy to initiate that flow if FinTechCo wants.

If you want a one-pager I can send a red-team approved blurb for procurement. Also happy to join your security sync next week.
